cohort: The study included 22 patients who underwent uterine artery embolization at a single institution for iatrogenic uterine vascular injuries (arteriovenous malformations or pseudoaneurysms) following procedures such as uterine curettage, manual vacuum aspiration, or cesarean surgery.
finding: Uterine artery embolization (UAE) was found to be a safe and effective treatment for iatrogenic uterine vascular injuries, leading to cessation of bleeding in 86.4% of patients and allowing for the preservation of uterine function with the possibility of future pregnancy.
